verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OCI has an IAM system where policies govern control of resources in tenancies, plus identity domains. The CLI also supports token-based authentication as an alternative to keypairs. Together these suggest credentials can be bound to policy-scoped identities, but nothing in the pack explicitly describes issuing least-privilege API keys for a non-human agent. Missing for 10: explicit docs on creating scoped API keys or tokens for a service or agent identity (e.g., a dedicated agent principal), examples of least-privilege policy authoring, credential expiry and rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
